Act gives one agent one cited item, a friction entry or a committed dream's
finding, with its sources and a scope: the ceiling of what it may change.

  ask     it reads, and asks a person one question; it changes nothing
  fix     also edits in its own worktree, runs the item's check, crawls
          the index
  commit  also commits there, and does local upkeep git keeps safe:
          brings a branch up to date with the default branch, removes
          worktrees and branches already merged into it, cleans up ended
          helpers whose work is committed
  branch  also lands its commits on the repo's act/landed branch, which a
          person merges

Its verbs check the scope and their guards in code, and each is logged on
the run with the run's sources. No scope reaches a default branch, a push,
an install or the bus. One run at a time on this host; a person starts
(start), watches (list, show) and stops (stop) them. The run's agent is
Claude in don't-ask mode, which reads the scope, edits only its worktree,
and runs only its reading commands, its verbs and git that reads.

Usage:
  agent dream act [flags]
  agent dream act [command]

Examples:
  agent dream act start friction:host-ab12cd34ef56 --scope commit --repo ~/dev/app --check "make test"
  agent dream act start finding:14 --scope ask --summary "the index lists build output" --source dream:14
  agent dream act list
  agent dream act stop 3 --note "not now"

Available Commands:
  start           Start a run on a friction entry or a dream's finding (a person)
  list            List the act runs (--all: finished ones too)
  show            Show an act run: its item, scope, worktree, log and how it ended
  stop            Stop an open act run and clean up its agent (a person)
  note            Add a line to your run's log (its agent)
  ask             Stop with one question for a person (its agent)
  done            End your run, saying what you did (its agent)
  give-up         End your run without finishing, saying why (its agent)
  check           Run your item's check in your worktree (its agent; fix and up)
  commit          Commit what your worktree holds, with the run's trailers (its agent; commit and up)
  land            Land your branch on act/landed, which a person merges (its agent; branch)
  rebase          Bring a branch up to date: yours onto act/landed, another worktree's onto its default branch (commit and up)
  remove-worktree Remove a merged, clean, idle worktree of a scoped repo (commit and up)
  delete-branch   Delete a local branch merged into the default branch (commit and up)
  cleanup-agent   Clean up an ended helper whose work is committed (commit and up)
  crawl           Bring the index up to date for one project (fix and up)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for act

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent dream act [command] --help" for more information about a command.
